added.title: Head of Engineering
added.description:
Solvable · Head of Engineering
Full-time · Orange County, CA (Newport Beach / Irvine, in person 3+ days) · Reports to CEO · Target start: November 2026

About Solvable

Solvable is rebuilding how Americans discover, evaluate, and access insurance.
We help consumers lower their auto and home insurance premiums without sacrificing coverage or service. Under the hood, we are building an AI-first marketplace powered by conversational agents, agentic marketing systems, predictive intelligence, and real-time consumer + carrier routing.
We've already helped millions of consumers save money. Now we're scaling aggressively and investing in owned platform, data, and decisioning capability as a core competitive advantage.
Why This Role Now

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to own the platform end to end: the data foundation, the conversion signal infrastructure, the owned consumer runtime, and the models that decide what we ask, show, route, and sell.
Our engineering team is senior and distributed offshore. It is producing real work. What it does not have is an owner in the business's time zone: someone accountable for architecture, delivery, and uptime who is awake when the numbers break and in the room when the decisions get made.
This is not a delivery-management seat.
This is not a role where you set strategy and delegate.

This is a builder's role with a leadership mandate. You'll write production code in your first 30 days, review everyone else's, and be personally accountable for systems that make money every hour. You'll know you're doing it right when the business stops asking which number is correct.

Your Impact

You will own Solvable's engineering function across four core domains.
1. Revenue Truth & The Data Platform

Own the data foundation end to end: ingestion, transformation, governance, lineage, and quality gates on a modern lakehouse
Reconcile spend, leads, routing outcomes, partner results, and gross profit into one source the business acts on
Replace fragmented, manually assembled reporting with governed, explainable, self-serve access
Set and hold the standard for freshness, accuracy, consent handling, and access control across consumer data

2. Measurement Infrastructure

Own the measurement infrastructure, canonical event model, and partner callback capture that carry attribution for every dollar of media spend
Migrate revenue-critical tracking off shared infrastructure without disrupting live revenue, validated in parallel, never big-bang
Make measurement reliable enough that media, finance, and our platform partners all work from the same numbers

3. Owned Runtime & Experimentation Velocity

Own the consumer experience and the monetization services behind it: intake, consent, routing, offer presentation, and partner handoff
Build the instrumentation that lets product run conversion, yield, and lifecycle experiments in parallel, idea to instrumented test in days rather than weeks
Protect uptime and latency on revenue-critical paths

4. Decisioning, ML & The Team

Sequence and build the intelligence layer: lead quality scoring, expected-value routing, and bind probability, trained on our own outcome data
Lead, mentor, and hold the technical bar for a senior distributed team across full-stack, data, and infrastructure
Own hiring, ramp, operating cadence, and capacity planning, including the US engineering roles that follow this one
Answer the question we ask of every role at Solvable: why can't a system do this?

Responsibilities

Set architecture and make the calls, then stay close enough to ship. You will be in the codebase.
Run delivery: sprint cadence, spec quality, and a forecast leadership trusts
Serve as the senior technical resource and daily escalation point for a distributed team several hours ahead
Own CI/CD, observability, role-based access, PII and consent handling, and auditability
Work directly with platform and data partners on integrations, requirements, and technical negotiation
Report to the CEO and present progress against gates to the board

What We're Looking For

Experience & Track Record

8+ years building software, 3+ leading engineering teams that shipped revenue-critical systems
You have personally owned a production data pipeline the business bet revenue on, and you know what it feels like when finance finds the error before you do
You have migrated off shared or partner infrastructure without breaking revenue
You have shipped production ML that changed an operational decision. Not dashboards, not research.
You have led engineers across a time-zone gap and you have a real method for it, not just good intentions

Technical Fluency (Non-Negotiable)

Hands-on with our stack or close equivalents: AWS (Fargate, Kinesis, Glue, Redshift), Python, TypeScript/Node, modern data tooling (dbt, Iceberg or equivalent lakehouse patterns), event-driven architecture
You have written production code in the last six months
AI-native. You use AI tooling to collapse execution cost and you expect the same from your team.
You think in tradeoffs and can defend an architecture decision on cost, risk, and time to revenue

Fit

You thrive in ambiguity and would rather define the plan than receive it
Performance marketing, lead generation, insurtech, or ad-tech experience is a strong plus. If you don't have it, you'll be fluent in CPL, RPL, ROAS, and attribution within your first month.
Based in Orange County or committed to relocating. This role exists because the business needs its engineering owner in the same time zone and the same building. Regular in-person time is the job, not a preference.

Compensation

Base salary is $210,000 to $250,000, and we anchor mid-market on cash so we can pay the difference in scope and equity. The package also includes an annual performance bonus gated on a year-end scorecard and an equity grant vesting over four years with a one-year cliff, which is where the real upside sits.

Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30 · Take the reins.
Own the delivery board, sprint cadence, and a forecast leadership trusts. Classify every route through our current tracking infrastructure: analytical, routing, monetization, and callback. Inventory source systems, owners, and access boundaries. One-on-ones with every engineer and with the media, product, and creative leads. Ship something small to production in week two.
Days 31–60 · Make the numbers true.
Daily reporting live with visible freshness and discrepancy states, validated against the incumbent path. Canonical event model implemented for revenue-critical flows. You are the engineering team's daily escalation point and the delivery path runs through you. Deliver your written read on team structure and what the org needs next.
Days 61–90 · Prove it.
Conversion signal fully owned and accepted by media and finance, with the legacy path decommissioned or on a dated plan. All new work shipping on our own CI/CD. First expected-value or lead-quality model specified against real outcome data. Next-year engineering capacity plan delivered, with the AI-leverage case for every proposed role.
How We Hire

Our process is built around live work, not rehearsed answers. Expect a real diagnostic exercise with no prep time, a system design conversation on a problem we are actually solving, a scenario walkthrough under time pressure, an onsite in Newport Beach, and backchannel references. It is demanding on purpose, and it is the same standard we hold ourselves to.

Solvable is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation ranges are good-faith estimates for Southern California and final offers depend on experience and scope.

added.title: Vice President of Infrastructure
added.description:
Company Description
Animoca Brands is a leader in digital entertainment, blockchain, and gamified solutions that advance digital property rights and Web3 adoption. The company builds and invests in a wide range of products, platforms, and games that enable users to own, trade, and monetize digital assets. Guided by the principle of maximizing value and opportunity for its communities, Animoca Brands focuses on creating sustainable ecosystems for players, partners, and employees. The organization emphasizes innovation, collaboration, and long-term growth, offering team members the chance to work on cutting-edge technologies and global projects that shape the future of the open metaverse.
Role Description
The Vice President of Infrastructure is a full-time remote role responsible for leading the design, implementation, and optimization of Animoca Brands’ global technology infrastructure. This position oversees cloud and on-premise environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and cost-effectiveness across all platforms and services. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining infrastructure strategy, managing infrastructure roadmaps, coordinating cross-functional projects, and ensuring alignment with business objectives and product teams. The role also involves establishing and refining IT service management processes, monitoring performance and availability, and leading incident response and problem resolution. The Vice President of Infrastructure will manage and mentor a distributed technical team, collaborate with security and engineering leaders, and drive continuous improvement in operational practices, tools, and automation.
Qualifications

Strong infrastructure leadership experience, including cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments, with expertise in Infrastructure and IT Service Management.
Proven ability to define and execute IT Strategy that aligns technology investments with business goals, including long-term roadmapping and governance.
Demonstrated Project Management skills, with experience planning, coordinating, and delivering complex, multi-stakeholder infrastructure initiatives on time and within budget.
Deep understanding of Network Security practices, including secure architecture design, identity and access management, encryption, monitoring, and compliance frameworks.
Experience leading distributed teams in a remote environment, with strong communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making abilities.
Background in high-growth technology, gaming, Web3, or digital platforms is highly beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, ITIL, PMP, cloud certifications) are a plus.

Compensation & Financial Incentives

Highly Competitive Base Salary: $290,000 – $430,000 per annum, commensurate with experience and expertise.
Performance-Based Annual Bonus: 15% - 25% target annual cash bonus linked to individual and corporate milestone achievements.
Equity Participation: Generous Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) including Initial Equity / RSU (Restricted Stock Units) grant with a standard vesting schedule, allowing you to directly share in the company’s valuation growth.
Retirement Security: 401(k) retirement plan with an immediate company match of up to 4% - 6% (100% vested from Day 1).

added.title: National Director of Engineering Solutions
added.description:
The Engineering Solutions Director is a strategic, consultative leader responsible for growing and delivering complex, project-based engineering and technical solutions for enterprise clients. This role focuses on designing, selling, and implementing outcome-driven services that go beyond traditional staffing, including managed services, project delivery, and consulting engagements.
In this role, you will partner with executive-level stakeholders to solve complex workforce and technical challenges across sectors such as Energy, EPC, Utilities, Advanced Manufacturing, and Industrial Automation. You will own the full solution lifecycle — from opportunity identification and solution design through financial performance and client satisfaction — while driving multi-million-dollar portfolios and long-term strategic partnerships.
What you get to do:

Drive growth by identifying, qualifying, and closing complex, project-based engineering solutions (e.g., design-build, automation/controls, CAD services, CoE support)
Build trusted, executive-level relationships (VP Engineering, Directors of Projects, Plant Managers) to uncover business challenges and deliver value-based solutions
Design comprehensive Statements of Work (SOWs), pricing models, and delivery frameworks in partnership with internal SMEs
Own solution financials, including pricing strategy, cost modeling, margin management, and profitability
Expand solution penetration within existing Strategic, Mid-Market, and VMS accounts where staffing engagements have matured
Manage the client experience across the full project lifecycle to ensure outcomes, KPIs, and expectations are met
Translate complex engineering and technical challenges into clear business outcomes for clients
Use data and reporting to evaluate performance, manage risk, and continuously improve solution delivery
Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, delivery, and engineering teams to scale solutions effectively
Act as a thought leader and peer coach, sharing best practices and supporting practice-level growth

What you need to bring:

7–12 years of experience in engineering services, project-based consulting, or solutions-based selling
Proven success closing multi-million-dollar SOWs or managed engineering projects
Deep expertise in one or more verticals: Energy/EPC, Utilities, Advanced Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, or Renewables
Strong business acumen with the ability to design financially sound, scalable solutions
Executive-level communication skills with the ability to influence and present to senior client audiences
Demonstrated experience translating technical concepts into business value
Proficiency with CRM and pursuit management tools (e.g., Salesforce, Bullhorn)
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for building new revenue streams
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams
Willingness to travel as needed; hybrid work environment

Randstad offers competitive pay and bonus structures. Pay offered to a successful candidate will be based on several factors including the candidate's education, work experience, work location, specific job duties, certifications, etc. Based on eligibility, a successful candidate's total compensation may include a variable pay plan including bonus(es) and/or commission(s). In setting compensation, Randstad complies with all local wage and hour laws and while the pay range listed above is an annual amount, non-exempt employees will be paid hourly and therefore receive the hourly equivalent.

In addition, Randstad, the largest global staffing leader, offers rich learning & professional development opportunities, a 401(k) plan, a stock purchase plan, an employee referral reward program, and comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance to uniquely fit your needs. Randstad also focuses on our employees' overall wellbeing with our award-winning wellness program, employee assistance program, a generous time off policy (including at least 18 paid days off in your first full year, 1 paid volunteer day, 9 paid holidays, and 5 sick days), paid parental leave, paid caregiver leave, a health and dependent care flexible spending account, Metlife home and auto insurance offerings, a Metlife legal plan offering, and offers discounts on everything from cell phone plans to car purchases.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Age, Genetic Information, Disability, Protected Veteran Status, or any other legally protected group status.

We are seeking candidates from all backgrounds and demographics and a variety of industries to join our winning team! Randstad is proud to be included in the prestigious "America's Best Employers for Women 2024" list. Randstad US has also been recognized as a 2024 Leading Disability Employer by the National Organization on Disability (NOD). At Randstad, we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please contact hrsupport@randstadusa.com

added.title: Director of Technology Operations
added.description:
Director of Technology Operations
| Remote (US) | Full-Time | Direct Hire

Position Summary

Our Direct Client is looking for a Director Technical Operations
to own Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Corporate IT, Telecoms, and Info Security.

This role reports directly to the Chief Information & Technology Officer and is accountable for the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of their telecommunications and enterprise platforms.
You will drive operational excellence in a fast-paced, high-availability environment where uptime is critical.

What You’ll Do

Lead SRE, DevOps, NOC, Help Desk, Corporate IT, and Security teams, building a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Own end-to-end reliability and observability for their Carrier-grade telecom platforms (VOIP, SIP, carrier integrations), IoT, and enterprise systems. Define and manage SLIs/SLOs targeting >99.99% uptime with a clear roadmap to five-nines reliability.
Analyze service health metrics and trends proactively. Lead early investigations into anomalies, structured root cause analysis, and systemic fixes to reduce incident frequency and MTTR.
Establish rigorous production readiness standards (documentation, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, security reviews, and capacity planning) before new services launch.
Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams on architectural decisions to ensure operational sustainability and scalability.
Drive cloud infrastructure strategy and optimization across AWS and Azure — balancing performance, cost, security, and availability through automation and Infrastructure as Code.
Oversee Corporate IT and Security operations, including policy enforcement, vulnerability management, access controls, endpoint management, and compliance with telecom and data protection regulations (CPNI, FCC Title 47 Part 64, CCPA, NIST, PCI, etc.).
Implement and mature IT Service Management processes (ITIL/ITSM best practices) across SaaS platforms like Salesforce and Azure.
Develop annual operational plans and budgets aligned with business growth objectives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with cloud providers, telecom partners, and key vendors.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Business
10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, telecommunications operations, or high-availability production environments (VOIP, SIP, carrier integrations, contact center systems) with direct accountability for uptime, incident response, and SLAs.
5+ years of hands-on cloud experience (AWS and/or Azure), including architecture, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and monitoring.
6+ years of people leadership experience, including managing multi-tiered teams of 30+ professionals (SRE, DevOps, NOC, etc.).
Proven success designing observability frameworks (metrics, alerting, logging, dashboards) and using data to drive systemic improvements.
Strong experience with change management, production readiness reviews, and regulatory compliance in telecom/data environments.
Excellent analytical, budgeting, and communication skills with the ability to influence executive decisions through data.

Preferred:

ITIL certification or equivalent experience.
Familiarity with contact center technologies (Salesforce, InContact, Jira, etc.).

What Our Client Offers

Competitive compensation with annual bonus
Fully remote work environment.
Mission-driven company.
